question: How many time entries logged by {resource_role} resources have a matching task assignment on file?
fields: time_entries.task_id, time_entries.resource_id, resources.resource_id, resources.role, task_resources.task_id, task_resources.resource_id
judge: A single count of time_entries rows logged by resources of the named role whose (task_id, resource_id) pair exists in task_resources.
rationale: INNER JOIN time_entries to resources on resource_id and to task_resources on the composite (task_id, resource_id) membership key (pm_jp_010), filter to the role, count. Every time_entries row has a matching assignment by construction, so this equals the role's full time_entries count.
